description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight (Earth)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Stonega (0~2), removed after using Apex Stonega two times

description.name: Apex Stonega Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Stonega level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight (Earth)]

description.name: Apex Stonega Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Stonega level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Onion Knight (Earth)]
